title: statistical-reviewer output
description: Structured findings for one paper, per docs/statistical-review.md. One record per claim; the paper's verdict follows from the claims'.

reviewable.description: false when the deposit could not be obtained; every other field is then empty and `not_checked` carries the reason.

reproduction.description: Reported statistics reproduced from the deposit, before any judgement. Stated first because most papers are arithmetically perfect and the reader needs to know that.

software_conventions_resolved.description: Apparent discrepancies traced to an implementation convention rather than to the paper (R's one-tailed dunn.test, continuity correction, gaussian AIC, ...).

test_as_stated.description: the test the paper names, with its reported statistic and p

unit_used.description: the unit the test actually counted, and that n

unit_defensible.description: the unit the claim requires, and that n

recomputed.description: statistic obtained from the deposit, or the string 'not recomputable' with the reason

reanalysis.description: result at the defensible unit with the family correction applied

supported_sentence.description: for a supported or weakened claim, the sentence the data do support, written out

findings_against_the_paper.description: findings that attach to the paper as a whole rather than to one claim (family size, test selection, population, confounds)

rules_passed.description: rule identifier -> what was checked and what was found. A rubric that only lists failures cannot be audited.

caveats_on_this_review.description: where the review's own conclusions are close to a threshold or rest on an assumption

rule.description: an S, C or R identifier

observed.description: a number computed or a sentence read in the paper; never a restatement of the rule

fix.description: the smallest change that satisfies the rule

demonstrated_by.description: the table or figure that shows it; required for a blocking finding

script_only.description: true when the finding was invisible until the authors' analysis script was read in pass 2

changed_no_conclusion.description: true when the rule is broken but the outcome is unaffected
